purpose: Headless CI structural gravity preflight report. The website renderer does not run stiffness solves or engineering design.
assumptions: This is a conceptual gravity-load model, not a solved structural analysis model.
Floor dead load is 15 psf and floor live load is 40 psf.
Roof dead load is 18 psf and roof live or snow allowance is 20 psf.
Floor diaphragm area is reduced by a schematic stair opening.
Walls are represented as line load paths; wall openings and lintel behavior are not solved.
Structural support scheme uses the current masonry bearing-wall and wood diaphragm layout.
Support fixity is schematic and requires licensed structural engineering review.
warnings: No stiffness matrix has been solved yet.
No member demand/capacity ratios, drift checks, or foundation bearing checks are produced yet.
Gravity-only service and strength load combinations are reported for traceability, but lateral combinations are blocked until wind/seismic modeling is added.
Structural results are limited to source-traced gravity load takeoff and schema validation.
Heat-map colors are normalized to the current conceptual demand surface range, not an absolute code utilization ratio.

designChecks.label: Global stability and load path
designChecks.requirement: Verify complete gravity and lateral load paths from roof/floors through supports to foundation.

designChecks.label: Gravity member strength
designChecks.requirement: Check axial, shear, and bending demands against selected member capacities.

designChecks.label: Floor and roof deflection
designChecks.requirement: Check service-load deflections and vibration-sensitive spans.

designChecks.label: Foundation bearing and settlement
designChecks.requirement: Verify bearing pressure, footing size, settlement, basement wall lateral loads, and support reactions.

designChecks.label: Wind and seismic lateral system
designChecks.requirement: Model wind/seismic forces, diaphragms, collectors, shear walls/frames, anchorage, and overturning.
